conflicts_found: Two task registries coexist: AKATH_CORE/CANONICAL_TASK_REGISTRY.json (22 tasks) and AX_MASTER_BRAIN/AX_MASTER_TASK_REGISTRY_v2.json (10 tasks). The lifecycle spec does not choose between them; it defers to TASK_REPORTING_PROTOCOL.md. Surfaced, not resolved.

The lifecycle state enum differs from the status values in the registries (DONE/IN_PROGRESS/PENDING/OVERDUE/SUPERSEDED). The lifecycle states apply to the operational envelope; registry status remains authoritative for reporting. Surfaced, not silently merged.

lessons: A method that is only stated in chat is not embedded; it must live in a document the next session loads automatically.

Two registries and two status vocabularies already coexist here; record such conflicts rather than silently picking a winner.

previous_reflection.observed_state: The 'AX PC1 Roblox Open' workflow failed its interactive open/visual-capture phase on every run with OPEN_EVIDENCE_MISSING and PNG_COUNT=0, which had been read as a Studio or environment fault. Reading the run's own log showed the opposite: the script ran the smoke test, entered Play mode and captured 9 PNGs, then threw while serialising its result. Separately, a request to upgrade an existing Counter-Strike style Roblox FPS named 'beachline' was found to have no target: it exists in no branch, no workspace path, no registry, no org repository and no published Roblox experience.

evidence_checked.detail: FOCUS_TITLE set, SEND_F5, CAPTURE 1-5, STUDIO_ALIVE=True, CAPTURE_COUNT=5, then WRAPPER_CAUGHT: Argument types do not match at pc1-roblox-open.ps1:237
@() on List[object] and List[string] throws 'Argument types do not match'; .ToArray() and ForEach-Object both succeed
22 markers printed, then 'The current thread cannot read Technology (lacking capability RobloxScript)'; ground, collision and spawn checks absent

failure at step 'Wait for the open to finish' with NO_SMOKE_LOG, a different and later failure than before the fix

conflicts_found: The failure name OPEN_EVIDENCE_MISSING pointed at Studio, while the log showed the capture step had already succeeded.
SMOKE_DETAIL=22 checks passed conflicted with the 4 checks that never ran.
corrections_made: Replaced the false environment diagnosis with the actual serialisation throw.
Converted the capture and notes lists with .ToArray() in pc1-roblox-open.ps1.
Wrapped the Lighting.Technology read in pcall so the smoke test cannot abort partway and cannot report a short green list as a pass.
Restored the intended commit message after a stale /tmp message file amended onto correct content, and verified it with git log -1 --format=%B.
Reported that beachline could not be found instead of inventing a substitute project.
lessons: A check that reports a count must also know how many it meant to run; a short list of green checks is the failure mode, not a red one.
A script that finishes its work and dies serialising the result looks identical from outside to one that did no work; read the run log before blaming the subject of the evidence.
PowerShell 5.1 @() throws on a generic List; use .ToArray().
A commit message file is not durable state; verify the committed message, not the file you intended to use.
Confirm a named target exists before undertaking to modify it.
